Forces hard orbit key light, sun assignment, static reflection configuration, and cold baked reflection probe setup.
Uploads prologue-owned Aegir flow phase and valid flag; phase cadence scales continuously with GlobalQualityWeight.
Consumes _H8AegirFlowPhase when valid; falls back to _Time for non-prologue contexts.
Adds finite-checked ResolveSlerp using math.slerp; preserves ResolveNlerp compatibility.
Uses ResolveSlerp for transit and roll blend camera rotations.
Sets RenderSettings sun to Directional Light and serializes hard shadow settings.
